messages:
OpsBot: [INCIDENT] inference-router - sudden 5xx spike detected (severity: P2). Pager triggered to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-router
OpsBot: Alert details -> errors: ~8% 5xx increase, latency +200ms median, region: us-west-2
Anya Patel: quick heads up — I'm the scheduled primary tonight but I have an unexpected travel window and will be offline 02:00-06:00 UTC. There's already the 5xx spike above. Can someone pick up primary for that window?
Mike Chen: I can take 02:00-06:00 UTC. Taking pager now. @Anya send any handoff notes you want me to have.
Anya Patel: thanks @Mike. Handoff summary:
- Symptoms: routing layer returning 502/504 intermittently, small spike starting ~01:40 UTC
- Customer impact: a handful of PLG customers reported errors (CS ticket CS-4123), not billing-critical yet
- What I've tried: restarted router pod (restarts temporarily dropped errors), created a canary route to model-b, no permanent fix yet
- Suspected: scheduling pressure on gpu-pool nodes causing worker queue backpressure
Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-router#triage
Samir Rao: grabbed logs around the spike, excerpt below:
```
2023-11-13T01:45:12Z router ERROR downstream timeout id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=502
2023-11-13T01:46:01Z router WARN kv-cache miss spike seq=512
2023-11-13T01:46:28Z router INFO restart pod inference-router-7f9b8 (killed by OOM?)
```
Anya Patel: also saw that the autoscaler didn't kick up new nodes; suspect kube scheduling/saturated node resources.
Mike Chen: plan of immediate actions:
1) confirm node saturation (kubectl top nodes)
2) if saturated, scale nodepool by +2 nodes (terraform or cloud console)
3) if we can't scale quickly, route a small percent to region-b variants and notify CS
I'll run step 1 now and report. :thumbsup:
Liz H.: quick mute command if pages get noisy during manual ops (use sparingly):
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/pager/mute -d '{"service":"inference-router","until":"+2h"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Keep actions visible in the thread.
Mike Chen: `kubectl top nodes` -> us-west-2-gpu-pool nodes at ~92% CPU and memory creeping. Initiating scale +2.
DeployBot: Node pool scale job started (job-id: j-7745). Watching cloud job status.
Mike Chen: after scale kicked in, error rate dropped to ~1.2% and latency back to baseline for the last 10m. Monitoring for regressions.
Anya Patel: please confirm secondary for that window — @Samir can you be secondary 02:00-06:00 UTC?
Samir Rao: confirmed, I'm secondary for 02:00-06:00 UTC. I'll keep an eye on logs and the dashboard; will escalate if we see new spikes.
Mike Chen: updated the incident channel with a short pinned summary and the runbook link. I'll remain primary until 06:10 UTC to ensure a clean handback.
Liz H.: CS opened ticket CS-4123, small user subset reported 502s, they're watching and will alert if customers escalate.
Mike Chen: fallback plan captured: if errors re-emerge, route 30% to model-b variant and scale more aggressively; notify CS and enable additional logging throttles.
Anya Patel: thanks all. I'm switching calendar to OOO for the window and handing pager to @Mike now. Travel mode engaged :airplane:.
Mike Chen: ack — taking ownership. Reach me on mobile @mike for urgent escalations.
OpsBot: Pager rotation updated: Anya Patel removed from rotation 2023-11-13T02:00:00Z -> 2023-11-13T06:00:00Z, Mike Chen added as primary.
Samir Rao: quick watch command I added to the notes: `watch -n 30 \"kubectl get pods -l app=inference-router -o wide\"` — helps catch pod restarts/shifts quickly.
Mike Chen: node scale completed, errors trending down to baseline. Keeping an eye for 20 more minutes.
Anya Patel: huge thanks to @Mike and @Samir for the quick cover. Please leave any follow-ups in the incident doc.
Mike Chen: final handback at 06:08 UTC — handed back to Anya. Incident currently quiet, CS notified, will open a postmortem only if it recurs.
OpsBot: Incident state: resolved (for now). Use `ops reopen inference-router` if it returns.
